title: MARS settings, defined in include/mars_settings.toml
description: Options for MARS extraction, for RD DT data check here for more details.

ifs_cycle_start.description: Boundary model cycle start hour. Required to be set if bdcycle_start % bdcycle != 0

levelist.description: Dictionary (date:levels), with dates of change in the number of levels.

grid.description: Dictionary (date:resolution), with dates of change in the resolution.

start_date.description: Date from when are data available in Mars

GG.description: List of parameters for grid point data, for detailed information about the parameters check here

GG_soil.description: Parameters for grid point soil data, for detailed information about the parameters check here

grid_GG1.description: Grid parameter for mars request of GG1 fields

grid_ML.description: Grid parameter for mars request of model level fields

SH.description: Parameters for spectral harmonic data, for detailed information about the parameters check here

SHZ.description: Geopotential on ground, for detailed information about the parameters check here

UA.description: Upper air grid point parameters, for detailed information about the parameters check here

stream.description: Dictionary (run:stream) to use the right stream for a given run.

CAMS_NRT.title: CAMS near-real-time forecasts
CAMS_NRT.description: Parameters for the CAMS global (class=MC) forecasts, retrieved by the MarsprepCams task on the native CAMS grid when nrt_aerosols.active is true.

start_date.description: Date from when the hourly data are available in MARS, either a date or a duration relative to today (e.g. '-P30D')

type_AN.description: MARS type of the constant (analysis) surface fields

type_FC.description: MARS type of the forecast fields

grid_ML.description: Grid of the model level fields, 'AV' for the archived (native) grid

SH.description: Spectral parameters retrieved at every step, for detailed information about the parameters check here

SH_wind.description: Spectral wind parameters (vorticity, divergence), retrieved every SH_wind_interval and reused (with the step relabelled) in between

SHZ.description: Spectral orography, retrieved at step 0 and added to every step

SHZ_type.description: MARS type of the spectral orography

GG.description: Gridpoint surface parameters retrieved at every step, for detailed information about the parameters check here

GG_sea.description: Sea surface temperature and sea ice, retrieved at every step together with GG

GG1.description: Constant gridpoint surface parameters, retrieved from the analysis and added to every step

GG_snow.description: Multi-layer snow parameters (levtype SOL), retrieved every GG_snow_interval and reused (with the step relabelled) in between

GG_snow_extra.description: Surface parameters archived with the same interval as GG_snow and handled the same way

GG_snow_interval.description: Archiving interval of GG_snow and GG_snow_extra

UA.description: Upper air gridpoint parameters (humidity, aerosols, ozone) retrieved at every step, for detailed information about the parameters check here
